findings.title: Linux-only mutation controls have no execution venue
findings.section: Definition of Done / Verification Contract — Proof obligations
findings.why_it_matters: The plan cannot produce caught-mutation evidence (R3, proof that each repaired assertion catches its target regression) for most repair rows. About 15 of the 24 rows run only on Linux builders or Linux VMs, for example F1–F3, F13, F14, F18–F23 and F11's installed pinentry. The plan says no Linux/KVM builder is available locally. It hands Linux work to CI, but CI builds only the unmutated published head and never runs the deliberately broken controls. As written, the LFG workflow can publish and watch the PR with no route to meet the DoD row 'Every F1-F24 row has … recorded caught-mutation evidence on a supported platform.' The Goal Capsule only covers implementation and publication without Linux builders, so mutation proof for these rows is left without an owner. The user has to choose how the Linux mutation runs happen, because that choice changes infrastructure and timing.
findings.suggested_fix: Name how the Linux and VM mutation controls will run. One option is temporary mutation commits on a scratch branch that CI builds; the other is a Linux/KVM builder that the user provides. Until those runs pass, state that F rows owned on Linux are pending mutation evidence and the DoD is not met. Do not let publication on the unmutated head stand in for R3.
evidence: Unavailable Linux builders do not prevent implementation or publication for CI.
Every F1-F24 row has implemented owner proof and recorded caught-mutation evidence on a supported platform.
Each repair register row has an owner assertion, a passing unmutated control and a deliberately broken control that fails for its intended reason (R3).
Linux checks, Linux host builds and all VM tests were unavailable because no Linux/KVM builder was available and Podman was stopped.

findings.title: hostClosureChecks updates missing from U9 integration handoff
findings.section: U9 — Serial shared integration and evidence reconciliation / Verification Contract
findings.why_it_matters: Several repairs change check bodies so they read materialized host or home generations instead of option values: F2/F3 Gemini/Codex on the Linux user matrix, F13 registry drop-in, F22 udev and F23 sysctl. The Verification Contract requires any check that newly reads a host generation to be added to `hostClosureChecks` in `flake.nix`. Under KTD5 (U9 exclusively owns `flake.nix`), only U9 can make that edit. U9 says it updates shard membership 'only if declarations actually change', and the integration inputs it lists cover only pinentry (U3) and the D3 option clause (U8). A check whose declaration is unchanged but which now reads a host generation would therefore stay out of the hosts shard and run in the wrong CI shard.
findings.suggested_fix: Require every unit in U1–U8 to state in its integration notes whether each changed check newly reads a host or home generation. Change U9's approach so it adds every such check to `hostClosureChecks`, whether or not its declaration changed. Keep the other shard-membership edits limited to declaration changes.
evidence: Any changed check that newly reads a host generation must enter `hostClosureChecks` in `flake.nix` so its build runs in the hosts shard.
update shard membership only if declarations actually change.
U1-U8 integration notes; U3 must specify installed pinentry input, U8 the removed option clause.
KTD5. Give U9 exclusive ownership of `flake.nix` and `docs/provisioning.md`.

findings.title: U6 learning cross-reference points to nonexistent location
findings.why_it_matters: An implementer following U6's Patterns line looks for learnings 'cited under KTD1's method in the Sources below' and finds none. KTD1 cites no learnings, and Sources sits in the Product Contract above U6, not below it. The materialized-output learnings U6 needs are in the Verification Contract under 'Required learning references', for example nix-check-reads-option-value-not-materialized-output. Pointing the reference there sends readers to the right list.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'learnings cited under KTD1's method in the Sources below' with 'learnings listed under Required learning references in the Verification Contract'.
evidence: learnings cited under KTD1's method in the Sources below.

residual_risks: U3 test scenario 5 (installed Linux pinentry compiles and selects packaged delegates) can only be checked once U9 wires the installed proof into `flake.nix`. U3 is therefore not independently verifiable, even though the plan says U1–U8 can proceed independently.
deferred_questions: Does the CI workflow run `vmChecks.all` (KVM) on the PR head? If not, who produces the VM-test evidence that merge readiness requires?
